description.value: The Canadian Brewhouse is a large western-Canadian chain sports bar and restaurant with dozens of locations, known for a broad food menu, extensive beer selection, and wall-to-wall screens for live sports. The Prince George location features a licensed patio, table reservations, a kids menu, and online ordering, making it a full-service dine-in destination near the Recplace recreation complex. Touring cyclists passing through Prince George will find a reliable, high-capacity food stop with takeout available.
